Initial release of HR Consultant Video

- Enables HR consultants to create short, capability and trust-building videos for potential clients.
- Guides users to select video type (overview, service-specific, compliance, culture, etc.).
- Collects details on services, client size, industry focus, and proactive advisory work.
- Generates 60–90 second scripts showcasing expertise, real client impact, and proactive problem prevention.
- Supports marketing and client communication for HR consultants serving small businesses.
